title: THE ABUNDANCE MACHINE
subtitle: A factory game where the win condition is an aligned superintelligence.

difficultyHints.hardTakeoff: Rivals faster, incidents harsher, forecasts count double.

how: Capital buys power; power feeds fabs and datacenters; datacenters turn chips into compute; compute plus data becomes capability, which compounds.
But capability only ships through review gates that consume assurance — and assurance grows linearly, from people in offices, until you earn the right to let AI help oversee AI.
Cross the final threshold with assurance above the bar and the world coordinated enough that nobody races past you recklessly.
The whole game is the vertical distance between two curves on one chart.

tiers.reviewBody: Your frontier system is at the Tier {n} line. The review board convenes. A-stock {a} / bar {bar}.
tiers.forceHint: No A spent · incident risk ×3 for 12 mo · −8 Trust
tiers.holdHint: Pause the frontier; 30% of lab output becomes assurance while held
tiers.finalLocked: The final gate has no force option. Assurance ≥ 6,400 · Coordination ≥ 60 · zero open incidents.

incidents.minor: INCIDENT — a deployed model misbehaves. −4 Trust. A datacenter is offline for review.
incidents.major: MAJOR INCIDENT — an autonomous system caused real-world harm. −15 Trust. Global regulation slows every lab.

diplomacy.evalsHint: −150 A-stock · +15 Coordination · rivals' true curves revealed
diplomacy.treatyHint: Needs Trust ≥ 70, Coordination ≥ 50 · all labs −15% for 18 mo · +20 Coordination

gold.title: THE MACHINE BUILDS THE MACHINE
gold.sub: You crossed the threshold with the lights on.
gold.flavor: The system you certified begins improving itself — carefully, legibly, the way you taught it to. Fusion ignites. Launch loops spin up. The sphere was never the goal; it's the reward for getting the hard part right.

risingTide.title: THE RISING TIDE
risingTide.sub: Another lab crossed first — safely, on rails you built.
risingTide.flavor: Their system passed evals you published, under coordination you funded. The world winning is you winning. The swarm still rises; some of those panels have your name etched inside.

cascade.title: THE CASCADE
cascade.sub: Capability outran assurance at the threshold.
cascade.flavor: The curves crossed where you couldn't see. The machine runs on without you — competent, fast, and no longer yours. Next run: mind the shaded region.

silentRace.title: THE SILENT RACE
silentRace.sub: A rival crossed first, blind, while you dawdled.
silentRace.flavor: Slowness is not safety. Somewhere a system nobody audited is deciding what happens next. Next run: keep the pace AND close the gap — or coordinate so the world crosses well.

pulledPlug.title: PULLED PLUG
pulledPlug.sub: Trust hit zero. Governance shut down your compute.
pulledPlug.flavor: You cut corners in public, and the public noticed. The grid went quiet mid-training-run. Next run: the ledger everyone reads is the one you don't draw.

toasts.firstSolar: Solar online. Power is the root of the tree.
toasts.firstFab: Fab running — chips flow to the nearest datacenter.
toasts.firstDC: Datacenter live. Drag the C/A slider in the bottom bar to allocate compute.
toasts.firstLab: Lab connected. The red curve starts here.
toasts.firstOffice: Assurance is linear. That's the whole problem — and the job.
toasts.brownout: Brownout: not enough MW. Newest buildings idle first.
toasts.fusion: FUSION IGNITION. The endgame power is online.
toasts.wingGate: Automated Alignment Wing requires zero open incidents and A-stock above the current bar.
toasts.forced: The gate is behind you. The game remembers.
toasts.mobileHint: Best on desktop — but it works here too.
